cellMapDesigner.title: Cell Map Designer
cellMapDesigner.description: Cell Map Designer is an online tool that allows the graphic representation of cell towers and related coverage areas together with points of interest.
cellMapDesigner.paragraph1: It allows you to insert, modify and delete cell towers whose position is known. It has a ruler tool to measure distances.
cellMapDesigner.paragraph2: The tool allows importing multiple cell towers by uploading CSV files, and importing and exporting cells and points of interest via GeoJSON files.
cellMapDesigner.paragraph3: It also supports exporting KML files and importing KMZ overlays for compatibility with Google Earth.
cellMapDesigner.paragraph4: You can customize point of interest (PoI) icons thanks to the TomSelect library and manage icons directly from the sidebar, which is now resizable.
cellMapDesigner.paragraph5: You can show/hide cells and overlays, manage multiple overlays simultaneously and view a PoI table with automatic polygonal area calculation.
cellMapDesigner.paragraph6: The layout is fully responsive and numerous icons and a custom logo have been added.
cellMapDesigner.paragraph7: Among recent improvements: multiple overlay import, PoI table fix, image management optimization, and improved buttons.

privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy

privacy-policy.technicalCookieDesc: essential for the website to function, such as session management and navigation preferences.
privacy-policy.preferenceCookieDesc: store user choices (e.g. language, theme) to improve experience.
privacy-policy.cookieInfo: The website does not use profiling, marketing or tracking cookies and does not integrate third-party services that collect data for advertising or statistical purposes.
privacy-policy.i18nextCookieDesc: stores the selected language, if present.
privacy-policy.consentCookieDesc: stores the user's choice regarding cookie acceptance.

privacy-policy.consentInfo: On first access a banner is displayed to manage cookie consent. You can change your preferences at any time through your browser settings.
